baseline_models.mechanism: Descent installs the object in a fitting rank as a corrective judgment, while Arabic articulation makes that restraint publicly discriminable rather than merely imposed.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing in its fitting station makes descent function as installation of the ruling.
Restraint that repels disorder supplies the ruling's corrective force.
Judgment between parties supplies the ruling's discriminating and adjudicative function.
Explicit articulation makes the installed judgment intelligible and answerable in speech.

changed_reading.before: A revelation delivered in Arabic as a ruling.
changed_reading.after: A ruling deliberately installed in an articulate form so that it can restrain disorder and adjudicate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَاءَهُم بَعْدَمَا جَاءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ (6-11)
baseline_models.mechanism: Following aligns the reader behind plural inclinations; because knowledge has already arrived as disclosure and mark, the act is a change of trajectory, with live images of inward tilt, vacancy, and fall.

activation_trace.role: Treading behind another turns obedience into alignment with a preceding course.
The soul's inclination supplies the ordinary motive drawing that course.
Falling into a depth exposes the possible direction and consequence of the inclination.
Later-than sequencing makes prior knowledge the crossed threshold, not a simultaneous rival.
Arrival gives knowledge achieved presence before the warned turn.
A distinguishing mark makes knowledge function as a visible guide from which the new course departs.

changed_reading.before: Do not obey their preferences despite knowing better.
changed_reading.after: After knowledge has arrived as a distinguishing guide, taking up their successive inclinations is a deliberate rerouting whose latent vector is vacancy or fall.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَا لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا وَاقٍ (13-19)
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired negation removes two nonidentical layers: a near party able to take charge or stand in support, and a barrier able to intercept harm.

activation_trace.role: Unseparated nearness supplies the relational proximity denied by the first noun.
Taking charge of an affair supplies the missing administrative guardianship.
Supportive alliance supplies the missing advocacy or aid.
A barrier that turns harm aside supplies the distinct protective layer also denied.

changed_reading.before: No one will help or protect you from God.
changed_reading.after: Deliberate departure leaves neither a proximate guardian who can assume the affair nor a shield that can absorb its consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah frames descent through binding inscription, detailed separation, evidentiary fixation, and finally an unreviewable حكم; this strengthens the focus حكم as an operative governing criterion, not a free-standing maxim.

activation_trace.role: Adjudication anchors the contextual administrative sequence in the focus noun.
Lucid expression makes the governing criterion inspectable.
A written fixing that obligates judgment supplies the rule's binding-record layer.
Detail that exposes parts and meanings supplies the criterion's articulated internal boundaries.
The renewed binding record at each term extends governance into timed determination.
Proof and establishment supply the positive fixing operation paired with erasure.
An airtight, firmly made حكم supplies the terminal image of a determination no reviewer loosens.

structural_cues: 13:1-2 opens with book, truth, and detailed signs; 13:38-41 closes with term/book, erasure and fixation, then a حكم with no تعقيب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription, detailing, fixation, and final judgment; I infer that sequence characterizes how the focus حكم operates. The live alternative is that حكم simply names the revelation's legal content.

changed_reading.before: The Arabic revelation contains a ruling.
changed_reading.after: The descended Arabic form is itself the articulated, binding, and administered criterion by which matters are fixed and judged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fulfill/connect sequence and its exact inverse, breaking after binding and cutting what was ordered joined, recast following desire after knowledge as post-ratification breach rather than private inconsistency.

activation_trace.role: A consequence or claim that follows a person makes the chosen following carry liability.
Succession after a prior event anchors the breach on the far side of received knowledge.
A guarded covenant supplies the relation that knowledge can establish and conduct must keep.
A confirmed pact supplies the point of ratification.
Unbroken succession supplies the positive conduct of maintaining commanded linkage.
Undoing what was firmly made supplies the inverse action of breach.
The repeated after-binding construction directly activates the focus after-knowledge construction.
Severing an existing connection supplies the social result of the breach.

structural_cues: 13:20-21 gives الوفاء plus nonsevered connection; 13:25 reverses both with نقض من بعد ميثاقه and قطع.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel kept and broken bonds; I map their after-binding reversal onto after-knowledge in the focus. Ordinary temporal culpability remains a live, less relational reading.

changed_reading.before: Following desire after learning is an epistemic lapse.
changed_reading.after: It is also a breach after ratification: a known bond is unmade, commanded linkage is cut, and a liability follows the new allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured descent carries raised foam while what benefits remains; the later knowing of descent as truth activates knowledge as the durable mark and desires as a conspicuous but vacant surface current.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from above anchors the hydrological sorting analogy in the focus descent.
Air and vacancy supply the possible lack of substance beneath plural inclinations.
A distinguishing mark makes knowledge the stable discriminator between residue and surface.
Fit between a thing and its measure supplies calibrated reception rather than indiscriminate flooding.
Floating froth supplies the visible, rising, but nonenduring surface layer.
Loss of truth and stability identifies what the sorting process removes.
Stable remaining after delay supplies the durability of benefit and knowledge.
Recognizing the descended truth confirms knowing as the successful result of the sorting process.

structural_cues: 13:17 moves from descent through capacity, carried foam, disappearance, and beneficial remaining; 13:19 contrasts knowing the descent as truth with blindness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a material sorting sequence and then explicit recognition; I map surface foam to the focus inclinations and what remains to knowledge. The analogy may instead concern truth and falsehood only at a broader level.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge and desires are two competing mental contents.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge is the tested remainder and visible mark left by descent, while desires can be the high, mobile surface that recruits pursuit without enduring substance.

context_deltas.mechanism: A claimed report without knowledge becomes outward saying, is beautified, and diverts from a path; this activates أهواءهم as socially circulated, decorated positions as well as private appetites.

activation_trace.role: False or empty talk supplies a speech-domain edge within the focus root's branch field.
Clear articulation supplies the counter-form against which decorated saying is tested.
An arriving report supplies the asserted informational content that lacks knowledge here.
Outward emergence supplies the merely manifest surface of the claim.
Saying what is not supplies the branch-level risk latent in an appearance made only of speech.
Making something look good supplies the attraction by which the claim recruits assent.
Turning aside supplies the causal displacement produced by the ornamented claim.
A traversable extended road supplies the course from which followers are redirected.

structural_cues: 13:33 grammatically sequences naming, informing without knowledge, outward speech, beautification, and diversion from the path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies that rhetorical-to-spatial sequence; I infer it is one mechanism by which their أهواء recruit following. Personal appetite remains an equally live reading.

changed_reading.after: They can also be attractive public positions: informationally hollow speech is made presentable, then becomes a route-changing social current.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context separates preserving attendants, reversal of an adverse determination, a wali's control or alliance, ownership of benefit and harm, and a waqi's barrier; the focus pair therefore names distinct failed layers of recourse.

activation_trace.role: Standing over an affair anchors the first denied layer as guardianship and control.
A damage-intercepting barrier anchors the second denied layer as shielding.
Active guarding supplies the ordinary preservation layer present before adverse determination.
Turning something back supplies the unavailable reversal once harm is willed.
A governor who assumes the affair supplies the exact missing recourse after nonreversal.
Allied support identifies the supposed awliya whose efficacy is tested.
Benefit supplies one outcome the supposed allies cannot own even for themselves.
Harm supplies the opposite outcome they likewise cannot control.
Painful penalty supplies the concrete harm for which no barrier is available.
The repeated absent barrier isolates protection from the wali's relational role.
Placing oneself in protection supplies the positive counterpart to the absent waqi.

structural_cues: 13:11 presents guards, then no reversal and no والي; 13:16 tests awliya by benefit/harm; 13:34 repeats no واق; 13:35 presents اتقاء as the opposite posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separate actors, operations, and outcomes; I infer ولي and واق coordinate two failure modes rather than restating one. Rhetorical synonymy remains possible.

changed_reading.before: No helper or protector can intervene.
changed_reading.after: There is no one to assume or advocate the affair, no power to reverse the determination, and no barrier to intercept its realized harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: Detailing, partial denial, conveyance, witness, and book-knowledge make Arabicness an evidentiary affordance: the حكم is articulated so that acceptance, rejection, testimony, and accountability can attach to determinate content.

activation_trace.role: Lucid expression anchors public testability in the focus adjective.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic result against which response is judged.
A tongue that separates matters through exposition supplies communicative discrimination.
Refusal to recognize supplies an accountable response to disclosed content.
A delimited part makes the denial selective rather than an undefined reaction.
Delivering the message supplies the messenger's bounded communicative duty.
Knowledgeable declaration supplies the evidentiary endpoint of articulation.
Ordered letters and the written object supply a stable public reference for that testimony.

structural_cues: 13:36 immediately precedes the focus with rejoicing versus denial of a part; 13:40 limits the messenger to conveyance; 13:43 closes with witness and knowledge of the book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, selective response, conveyance, and testimony; I infer Arabic clarity enables that accountability. Arabic may still function primarily as the straightforward language descriptor.

changed_reading.after: Arabic also names the ruling's accountable explicitness: its content can be delimited, conveyed, partly denied, known, and witnessed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch-distant irrigation sense of ع ر ب; it remains anchored in عَرَبِيًّا and is reinforced by the surah's one-water and measured-descent sequences. Render it only as a material analogy carried by the branch field, not as a replacement gloss for Arabic.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from above supplies the incoming material of the irrigation analogy.
Corrective restraint supplies the regulating function imposed on the flow.
Watering made regular after variation supplies the odd but exact branch image of a stabilized delivery regime.
Giving water supplies the shared input across adjacent but differently productive plots.
Water itself supplies the common material whose reception varies.
A measure reaching its proper limit supplies channel capacity for the descended flow.
Floating froth supplies what regulated flow exposes and carries away.

changed_reading.before: Arabic is solely a linguistic modifier of the ruling.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the descended ruling also resembles a regularized irrigation regime: one articulated input is channeled by measure, differentiates reception, and exposes surface waste.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the concrete bridle branch of ح ك م and motion branches of ه و ي; it remains anchored in حُكْمًا, ٱتَّبَعْتَ, and أَهْوَاءَهُم and gains coherence from the harnessed-running sequence in 13:2. Render it as a control-system analogy, never as a claim that حكم literally means bridle here.

activation_trace.role: A bridle around the jaws supplies a concrete control that checks uncontrolled running.
Unbroken succession supplies continued travel along the adopted course.
Rapid rushing supplies the kinetic force of the inclinations.
Falling into a depth supplies the failure mode when rushing loses governance.
Harnessing and driving toward a purpose supplies controlled motion as the contextual comparator.
Running flow supplies sustained movement rather than a static moral state.
A fixed endpoint supplies the governed trajectory's proper terminus.

changed_reading.before: The ruling states a prohibition against desire.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the ruling is also the governing rein: abandoning it lets a followed sequence of impulses turn purposeful motion into acceleration and fall.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it contrasts the covering image of ك ف ر with the shielding image of و ق ي; it remains valid as a 13:33-34 material reversal anchored in the focus knowledge and absent waqi. Render it as a contextual paradox of pseudo-cover versus protection, not as lexical equivalence between the roots.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بَعْدَمَا جَاءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ... وَلَا وَاقٍ (8-19)

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower supplies what would have to be covered over.
A genuine barrier against harm supplies the protection explicitly absent.
Covering the truth supplies the pseudo-cover substituted for acknowledged knowledge.
Making the cover look attractive supplies why concealment can be mistaken for refuge.
The immediate repetition of no barrier completes the reversal from concealment to exposure.

changed_reading.before: Rejecting knowledge and losing protection are adjacent consequences.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, concealment is a false cover: beautifying what hides known truth feels sheltering, yet it culminates in the absence of any real shield.

strongest_changes: حُكْمًا عَرَبِيًّا becomes an installed, binding, publicly inspectable criterion rather than only a ruling expressed in Arabic.
Following desires after knowledge becomes both a rerouted trajectory and a breach after ratification.
The water-and-foam sequence distinguishes durable knowledge from attractive, mobile, potentially vacant surface currents.
ولي and واق resolve into separate layers of relational guardianship and damage-intercepting protection.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustains legal, hydraulic, kinetic, social, and evidentiary mechanisms at once. The odd irrigation, bridle, and pseudo-cover activations remain useful precisely when contained as branch-triggered analogies rather than forced glosses.
remaining_uncertainties: The irrigation and bridle readings are form-distant and should not displace the direct linguistic and juridical senses.
The 13:17 foam mapping may operate only at the broader truth/falsehood level rather than specifically naming أهواء.
The coordinated ولي/واق negation may emphasize one broad absence of aid even though the branch fields support distinct layers.
The decorated-speech reading of أهواءهم remains secondary to the ordinary reading of inclinations and desires.
